items.title: 11.7.2 Carbocation ki stability aur alkyl group ka inductive effect (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 11.7.2 with Figure 11.11, printed pages 258-259.

blocks.text: Alkenes ke reactions zyada tar carbocations se guzarte hain, to addition reactions se pehle un ki stability samajhna zaroori hai. Carbocation woh alkyl group hai jis ke kisi ek carbon atom par ek musbat charge ho. Sirf H se jura carbocation methyl carbocation hai; ek carbon (alkyl substituent) se jura primary (1 degree); seedha do carbons se jura secondary (2 degree); seedha teen carbons se jura tertiary (3 degree).

blocks.title: Inductive effect
blocks.text: Sath wale groups ya atoms ke electron kheenchne ya electron dene ke asar se sigma bond ki polarisation inductive effect hai. Alkyl groups jaisi electron dene wali species musbat inductive effect (+I) rakhti hain; halogen atom jaisi electron kheenchne wali species manfi inductive effect (-I).

Musbat charge wale carbon se jure alkyl groups electron dene wale hain; apne musbat charge ki wajah se carbocation electrophile hai. Inductive effect bonds par teer ke siron se dikhaya jata hai, alkyl groups electrons ko musbat carbon ki taraf dhakelte hue (Figure 11.11). Nateejatan carbocation kam musbat charge wala aur energy ke lihaz se zyada mustahkam ho jata hai, to stability alkyl groups ki tadaad ke saath un ke +I asar se barhti hai: tertiary carbocation, teen electron dene wale alkyl groups ke saath, sab se mustahkam hai.

blocks.alt: Qatar mein chaar carbocations: methyl (C+ par teen H), primary (aik alkyl group R), secondary (do R) aur tertiary (teen R). Surkh teer har R group ko musbat carbon ki taraf electrons dhakelte dikhate hain, aur neeche surkh teer methyl se tertiary tak barhta istehkaam dikhata hai.
blocks.caption: Inductive effect aur carbocations ka istehkaam (stability) (Figure 11.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: Carbocation stability ki tarteeb tertiary secondary se zyada primary se zyada kyun hai (Quick Check 11.6b; exercise Q.2i)?
blocks.explanation: Musbat carbon se jura har alkyl group sigma bonds ke zariye us ki taraf electron density dhakelta hai (+I asar), musbat charge ko phaila kar ghatata hua. Teen alkyl groups do se zyada dete hain, aur do ek se zyada, to tertiary ion sab se kam gatha hua charge aur sab se kam energy rakhta hai.

items: Carbocation: C+ wala alkyl group; C+ par carbons ki tadaad se methyl, primary, secondary, tertiary. Alkyl groups +I (dene wale), halogens -I (kheenchne wale); +I charge phailata hai, to stability 3 zyada 2 se zyada 1 se zyada methyl se.
